question: Which district has more paved road per 1,000 residents in 2025, Coldharbour or Stonecairn, and by how many km per 1,000 residents?
answer:
Coldharbour has more paved road per 1,000 residents by 18.50 km per 1,000 residents.  
ANSWER: Coldharbour | 18.50

matches.title: Coldharbour district profile (2025)
matches.text: Coldharbour lies on the Cold and was founded in 1845. The 2025 census counted 11,407 residents, up from 11,902 at the 2020 census, on an area of 2,318.0 square kilometres.
